desc: The military’s need for a magnified, self-luminous tactical sight that enhances target identification and increases hit probability on extended-range shots inspired the creation of the Trijicon ACOG 6x48 riflescope. To accomplish this, the 6x48 optic’s objective lens offers a very large eyebox. Like other members of the Trijicon ACOG line, the ACOG 6x48 riflescope is battery-free and waterproof to 500 feet. It also offers a M1913 rail so users can utilize accessories as necessary.
